newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Greek consul guard dies by accident in Albania.
newsitem.headline: Greek consul guard dies by accident in Albania.

text.p: The head bodyguard at the Greek consulate in a southern Albanian town killed himself accidentally on Tuesday while cleaning his gun, the Greek foreign ministry said.

Greek foreign ministry officials said police lieutenant Nikos Markakis shot himself in his room on the first floor of the consulate in Gjirokaster and his body was sent to hospital in the Greek town of Ioannina for an autopsy.
Anarchic, mafia-style violence afflicts Albania and some witnesses earlier said Markakis' death might have been the work of a sniper.
Gjirokaster was one of the areas hit by rebellion in February and March when public fury erupted over the collapse of crooked pyramid investment schemes.
A Greek man was murdered in Albania's violence-wracked southern port of Vlore last week.
